fullPassage: "Human nature likes order," wrote the economist Burton Malkiel in his seminal book A Random Walk Down Wall Street. "People find it hard to accept the notion of randomness." Malkiel popularized the idea that the movement of any individual stock in the market is essentially random — it's impossible to know why a stock is doing what it's doing. People who reliably make money from the market are those who own a diverse portfolio of different kinds of investments, which spreads out the risk, with the broader principle that the market, over the long haul, will eventually increase in value. Picking individual stocks, or betting on certain trends, is much closer to gambling than science. Which is why we shouldn't be too surprised that a cat is just as likely to make a killing on Wall Street as a day trader.

questions.passage: "Human nature likes order," wrote the economist Burton Malkiel in his seminal book A Random Walk Down Wall Street. "People find it hard to accept the notion of __________." Malkiel popularized the idea that the movement of any individual stock in the market is essentially random — it's impossible to know why a stock is doing what it's doing. People who reliably make money from the market are those who own a diverse portfolio of different kinds of investments, which spreads out the risk, with the broader principle that the market, over the long haul, will eventually increase in value. Picking individual stocks, or betting on certain trends, is much closer to gambling than science. Which is why we shouldn't be too surprised that a cat is just as likely to make a killing on Wall Street as a day trader.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① investment(투자): '무작위성의 개념'이 아닌 '투자의 개념'은 문맥 부적합
✅ ② randomness(무작위성): '사람들은 무작위성이라는 개념을 받아들이기 어렵다' ← 정답
❌ ③ value(가치): '가치의 개념'은 이 문장의 맥락과 부합하지 않음
❌ ④ principle(원칙): '원칙의 개념'은 뒤에 나오는 내용과 연결 약함

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① in the short term(단기적으로): 시장의 단기 전망이 아닌 장기 성장 원칙
❌ ② at any given time(어떤 시점에서든): 특정 시점이 아닌 장기간의 관점
✅ ③ over the long haul(장기적으로): '시장이 장기적으로 결국 가치가 상승한다' ← 정답
❌ ④ in a random manner(무작위로): 시장 상승이 무작위라는 것이 아님
det.tip: over the long haul=장기적으로(syn: in the long run)
